jobs.title: Senior Manager - Quality Assurance (Brewery QA Head)
Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Research & Development (R&D)**

**Company:**
Deconstruct

**Location:**
Bangalore – HSR Layout

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Deconstruct**

We’re a D2C skincare brand built on one belief: safe, sensible, honest skincare. No fairy-tale marketing. No filler ingredients. Just actives that work. We’re looking for an execution-focused, scientifically rigorous
**Assistant Manager – R&D**
who can own our innovation pipeline end to end, from formulation and claims to quality and launch, and help build science-backed skincare that delivers real results.

**What you’ll own**

* Own the end-to-end NPD and renovation pipeline and deliver
  **10–12 new product launches a year**
  on time against the product launch calendar.
* Lead formulation development for new launches and existing SKU renovations, from ingredient evaluation and optimization through compatibility studies to the final formula.
* Ensure seamless pilot batches and commercial scale-ups with third-party manufacturers, with zero RM- or PM-related challenges.
* Ensure every product meets its accelerated stability, freeze-thaw, compatibility and long-term stability requirements, and maintain
  **zero critical consumer complaints**
  across launched products.
* Develop all products within the target cost in the product brief, and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Lead
  **claims substantiation**
  across existing SKUs and at brand level. This includes planning and running efficacy, consumer perception and in-vitro/clinical studies with testing partners, and extending claims in line with brand and NPD goals.
* Explore and develop
  **potential RM blends**
  with ingredient suppliers to build product differentiation.
* Turn technical and claims data into consumer-relevant communication for Brand, Marketing and Customer Service teams.
* Deliver technical content for PDPs, social media campaigns, blogs, label artworks and marketing communications.
* Own
  **GRN approvals**
  for raw materials within TAT, and work with Quality to keep incoming material standards high.
* Run weekly cross-functional reviews with Brand, CS, Supply Chain, Procurement, Packaging, Quality and Regulatory, as well as with RM and FG vendors, to deliver OTIF.
* Maintain and update NPD project trackers, ensure no deviation from standard SOPs, and drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Manage formulation partners, CDMOs and ingredient suppliers, and evaluate new vendors and technologies.
* Guide and review the work of R&D associates and interns, and support their technical growth.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, formulation records and product specifications, and support regulatory and artwork approvals.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cosmetic Technology, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in skincare, cosmetics, personal care or pharmaceutical formulation development.
* A proven track record of taking multiple products from brief to commercial launch with third-party manufacturers.
* Strong expertise in emulsion systems, active ingredients, stability testing, scale-up and commercialization.
* Hands-on exposure to claims substantiation, including efficacy studies, testing labs and claim support documentation.
* Ability to manage a high-volume NPD pipeline in parallel without compromising timelines, quality or cost.
* Strong vendor management, project management and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Ability to explain complex science in clear, consumer-friendly language.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
* **Growth:**
  Ownership of the brand’s innovation pipeline, working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams on products from concept to launch.
* **Culture:**
  A fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven and ownership-focused environment with plenty of room to learn, innovate and grow.

**ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION**

* Experience in D2C skincare, beauty, cosmetics or FMCG brands is preferred.
* Experience running claims substantiation or clinical/efficacy studies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to BIS/CDSCO cosmetic regulations and claim compliance will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a strong passion for skincare innovation, emerging ingredients and consumer-centric product development will be given preference.

The antibody team is involved in engineering and development of antibodies, with a deep focus on reagent quality and specificity. * Extensive experience in expression and purification of recombinant proteins from bacterial, yeast, insect and mammalian systems

**Description**
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.
  
  
The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
* Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
* Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
* Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
* Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
* Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
* Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
* Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
* Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
* Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
* 5+ years of program or project Management experience
* Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
* Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent

This role is responsible for turning business questions into structured analyses, meaningful metrics, measurable KPIs, actionable insights, and decision- ready recommendations. The role combines traditional analytics, statistical methods, and business translation to improve planning, performance, and process decisions across the function. It contributes to team and business goals by identifying opportunities, testing hypotheses, and enabling stakeholders to act on reliable, well-explained data. The role also helps determine how a problem should be solved using data, whether through reporting, BI, traditional analytics, or advanced data science methods.

* Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reproducible, and well documented through validation checks, notebook discipline, version control, and clear metric logic.

**Experience:**

* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, advanced Excel, and one BI platform such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with Jupyter notebooks, GCP, and BigQuery.
* Proven experience in exploratory data analysis, reporting, dashboarding, data validation, and several of the following: statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, segmentation, cohort analysis, predictive modelling, time-series forecasting, or experimentation design.
* Experience partnering with stakeholders to frame business questions, define KPIs and success metrics, and translate findings into practical actions.
* Experience working cross-functionally and translating business needs into analytical or technical deliverables.

**Skills:**

* Strong technical skills in SQL, Python, Excel, data wrangling, dashboarding, statistical methods, data visualization, and basic ML workflows.
* Working knowledge of statistical and analytical libraries such as scikit-learn and stats models for basic modelling and analysis.
* Functional expertise in problem structuring, metric design, root-cause analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal reasoning.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain methods, assumptions, and recommendations clearly to non- technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset, high attention to detail, data-quality discipline, and comfort working independently in ambiguous environments.

**AI Skills (Mandatory):**

**Nice to Have:**

* Domain experience in retail, grocery, e-commerce, operations, pricing, supply chain, marketing, or customer analytics.

jobs.title: Food Quality Analyst — Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO)
Solutions Engineer (Pre-Sales) – Food Supply Chain Traceability
jobs.description:
**Bengaluru · Hybrid · 2–5 years**

Help India's food and agri companies, from FMCG majors to seafood and meat exporters, trace every unit from farm and factory to shelf. As our first-line technical expert in sales, you'll turn the real-world complexity of factories and warehouses into traceability solutions that executives buy and operators actually use.

**About Tralexho**

Tralexho is a patented Traceability-as-a-Service (TaaS) platform for the food and agri supply chain, from raw material and processing to warehousing, distribution and the end consumer. Customers use us to cut losses and counterfeits, recall with precision, and comply from day one with GS1, HACCP, USFDA FSMA 204, EUDR and other standards.

We won the
**MoFPI National Award 2025 for Food Safety & Traceability**
, were shortlisted in
**APEDA's Business Challenge 2026 for export-enabling technology**
, and were named to
**Forbes India DGEMS Select 200**
. We co-authored the
**BIS traceability standard for India**
, are part of NVIDIA Inception, and run AI traceability research with ICAR-CIFT and KUFOS.
*Designed in India, designed for the world.*

**The role**

You'll join the revenue team, reporting to the Head of Sales, and own the technical side of every deal: discovery, demo, proof-of-concept and handover to implementation. You'll work with Indian enterprises serving the domestic market and with exporters selling into the US, EU and beyond.

**What you'll do**

* Run technical discovery with plant heads, quality and supply-chain leaders, and IT, and map the customer's current flows of material, data and systems
* Deliver demos tailored to the customer's own products, lines and warehouses
* Design and run PoCs with product and engineering: scope them, set success criteria, deploy and present the results
* Specify and configure sensors and scanners (barcode/QR, RFID, environmental sensors) for PoCs and deployments, and work with hardware partners on the shop floor
* Answer integration, data and security questions (ERP/WMS, APIs, device connectivity) and compliance questions (FSMA 204, EUDR, GS1, HACCP)
* Write solution proposals and RFP/RFI responses, using AI tools to move fast without cutting corners
* Bring field insight back to product so it shapes what we build next

**Your first 90 days**

* **30 days:**
  Know the platform and our standard hardware set well enough to demo it end to end, and shadow live customer engagements
* **60 days:**
  Run discovery and demos on your own
* **90 days:**
  Lead a PoC, including on-site device setup, from scoping to customer sign-off

**Must-haves**

* 2–5 years (career breaks included) in B2B SaaS pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical consulting
* A solid grasp of SaaS architecture, APIs and data integration
* Comfort explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical buyers, and clear writing for proposals and RFPs

**Nice-to-haves**

* Supply chain, manufacturing, FMCG, seafood, meat or agri-export exposure
* GS1 standards, serialization, packaging aggregation or EPCIS
* SAP or other ERP/WMS integration experience
* Hands-on experience with scanners, sensors or other connected devices in a production or field setting
* Hindi, Kannada or another regional language for plant-floor conversations

**How we work**

We work hybrid. Most work is remote, and we meet in person 4–8 days a month (usually 1–2 days a week) at our Bengaluru HQ in Whitefield, or at customer sites. You'll need to live within commuting distance of Whitefield. Site visits are part of the role: typically once a month to customer plants, warehouses and processing centres, mostly day trips around Bengaluru during working hours. Some sites are meat and seafood processing facilities. Occasional outstation trips are planned in advance, travel and stay are arranged and paid by us, and your first visits are with a teammate.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay plus variable pay tied to revenue
* Real ownership in a small, award-winning team working on food safety at national and global scale

**Hiring process**

A 30-minute intro call → a technical conversation → a mock discovery and demo with our team → a conversation with our founders.

**How to apply**

Click the Apply link to go to our short application form. It takes about 10 minutes: your CV, a few practical details, and two brief questions in your own words. We'd rather explore your experience properly in conversation than ask you to write essays, and we appreciate your interest.

Bengaluru

The role will be responsible for building and managing strategic relationships, monitoring regulatory developments, and enabling seamless coordination between government agencies and internal business teams.

* Analyze regulatory developments and communicate actionable insights to relevant internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Corporate Affairs, Business Units, HR, Finance, Tax, infrastructure and other cross-functional teams to ensure timely implementation of regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Deputy General Manager - Corporate Governance
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced CS + CA professional to lead funding-related governance, corporate compliance, and financial regulatory matters for our real estate business in Karnataka.

The incumbent will play a critical role in ensuring robust governance across funding transactions, lender relationships, debt structuring, statutory compliance, listing compliance and corporate financial matters.

The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to real estate financing transaction, project funding, lender documentation, corporate governance, debt listing requirements and regulatory frameworks with the ability to work closely with senior management, financial institutions, investors, trustees and external advisors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Funding Governance & Debt Compliance**

* Oversee governance and compliance aspects of project funding, construction finance, term loans, working capital facilities, NCD’s and other debt arrangements and work closely with corporate strategy team.
* Ensure adherence to funding agreements, compliance of condition subsequent, lender covenants, security creation requirements, charge creation & modification if any and contractual obligations.
* Coordinate with Corporate strategy team on funding documentation, disbursement conditions, and ongoing compliance.
* Monitor debt-related regulatory requirements, covenant reporting, and repayment obligations.
* Support refinancing, debt restructuring, and funding-related due diligence.
* Establish governance frameworks for effective monitoring of borrowing arrangements and funding utilisation.
* Coordinate with legal, finance, treasury, and project teams to ensure compliance with funding conditions and documentation requirements.

**Corporate Governance & Secretarial Compliance**

* Manage Companies Act compliance, board meetings, committee meetings, statutory registers, and regulatory filings of allotted companies.
* Ensure timely ROC/MCA filings, including filings related to borrowings, charges, and corporate restructuring of allotted companies.
* Oversee board and shareholder approvals for funding transactions, guarantees, investments, and related-party transactions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI, FEMA, SEBI, BSE and other regulatory requirements based on the company's funding structures and transactions.
* Support corporate restructuring, subsidiary governance, and SPV-related compliance.
* Maintain strong corporate governance standards across group entities.

**Financial Controls, Risk & Compliance**

* Establish and monitor internal controls relating to fund utilisation, loan compliance, and financial governance.
* Ensure alignment between financing terms, project cash flows, and regulatory obligations.
* Identify funding-related compliance risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Coordinate statutory audits, lender audits, internal audits, and transaction-specific reviews.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, reporting, and audit trails for major financing transactions.
* Identify and comply related party transactions

**Stakeholder Management & Management Reporting**

* Work closely with the Director – Corporate Affairs, Legal Head, and senior management on funding governance matters.
* Liaise with banks, financial institutions, legal advisors, auditors, trustees, and regulatory authorities wherever required.
* Prepare governance reports covering borrowing positions, covenant compliance, security documentation, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide governance inputs on new funding proposals, financing structures, and strategic investment transactions

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualifications**

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS) and Chartered Accountant (CA).
* Additional qualifications in real estate laws, structuring, corporate finance, treasury, or financial risk management would be advantageous.

**Experience & Functional Expertise**

* 10–15 years of relevant experience, preferably in real estate or infrastructure development companies.
* Strong exposure to project finance, construction finance, structured funding, and debt governance.
* Hands-on experience in lender documentation, debt covenant monitoring, security creation, and charge registration.
* Deep understanding of Corporate Laws requirements and applicable financing-related regulations.
* Experience managing governance requirements for multiple SPVs and group entities and handling audit related queries.
* Ability to work effectively with CXO-level stakeholders, lenders, auditors, and legal advisors.

jobs.title: Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
**About Olyv**
Olyv (formerly SmartCoin) is an AI-powered fintech platform focused on making financial services more accessible and inclusive. Through digital lending, digital gold savings, credit health and financial wellness solutions, Olyv empowers individuals, micro-entrepreneurs and small businesses with convenient financial solutions.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Compliance Manager to strengthen our regulatory compliance framework and support business operations across digital lending, payment services and other financial products.
  
  
The role involves interpreting regulatory requirements, advising business and support teams, managing regulatory changes and ensuring effective implementation of compliance practices across products, partnerships and operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Change Management
* Monitor applicable RBI directions, NPCI guidelines, FIU-IND requirements and other relevant regulatory developments.
* Assess the impact of regulatory changes and coordinate with business and support functions to define implementation plans.
* Track compliance actions, responsibilities and timelines to ensure timely implementation.
* Product and Partner Advisory
* Review new products, lender partnerships, customer journeys across Olyv applications and partner platforms, including co-lending arrangements.
* Evaluate customer disclosures, marketing communications and significant process changes from a regulatory compliance perspective.
* Document compliance requirements and escalate unresolved regulatory risks before product or process launches.
* Policies and Procedures
* Draft, review and update compliance policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and operational checklists.
* Ensure alignment with applicable requirements relating to digital lending, BBPS, UPI, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), outsourcing, collections and grievance redressal.
* Regulatory Reporting and Inspections
* Maintain and monitor the regulatory obligations and compliance calendar.
* Coordinate documentation, supporting evidence and draft responses for regulatory filings, supervisory queries and inspections.
* Ensure regulatory submissions are appropriately reviewed and routed through the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO).
* Compliance Oversight and Training
* Prepare compliance updates and reports for the Board and senior management.
* Develop and conduct compliance awareness and training programmes for sales and support teams.
* Coordinate with Product, Risk, IT, Finance and Operations teams to monitor and close corrective action plans.
* Agreements and Business Arrangements
* Review business arrangements, partnership agreements and contractual documentation for regulatory compliance.
* Identify compliance gaps and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure necessary modifications and ongoing adherence to regulatory requirements.

**Candidate Profile**
**Educational Qualification**

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS).
* LL.B. qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in an NBFC, fintech or financial services organisation.

**Technical Skills And Expertise**

* Working knowledge of RBI, FIU-IND, SEBI and NPCI regulations and guidelines applicable to NBFCs, BBPS and UPI.
* Familiarity with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
* Strong understanding of regulatory interpretation, compliance documentation and policy drafting.
* Ability to assess regulatory risks and translate requirements into actionable compliance measures.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to consumer lending and digital lending journeys.
* Experience handling Lending Service Provider (LSP) arrangements and lender partnerships.
* Familiarity with supervisory reviews, regulatory inspections and lender-partner compliance assessments.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong analytical and regulatory interpretation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong documentation and drafting capabilities.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive compliance initiatives independently.
* A proactive approach towards identifying regulatory risks and ensuring timely resolution.

jobs.title: Consultant, Product - Tech, Insight
jobs.description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
This is a Consulting role for 3 - 6 months
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience (GRAISE)
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are looking for a talented Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions
  
  
Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions
  
  
Own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment — collaborating with software and ML engineers to ensure models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements at production scale
  
  
Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements
  
  
Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency
  
  
Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes
  
  
Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems
  
  
Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, collaborating with engineers to deploy computer vision models to production, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
**About The Team**
The GRAISE team (Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience) within World Wide Grocery Store Tech (WWGST) builds foundational AI and machine learning systems that power Amazon's in-store grocery technologies. We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. Our mission is to create technology which makes grocery shopping more convenient, economical, personalized, and enjoyable for customers while empowering retailers with operational efficiency
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms experience
* Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with large sets of data and deriving practical insights
* 2+ years of deep learning, computer vision, human robotic interaction, algorithms implementation experience
* Experience developing and evaluating data annotation and data quality metrics
* Demonstrated ability to take a model from research prototype to production deployment — including performance profiling, latency optimization, and working within serving infrastructure constraints
* Track record of clearly documenting experiments, writing technical design documents, and communicating results to cross-functional partners

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

### 

**What We Believe In**
----------------------

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

In this role, we are looking for an R&D Engineer – System 800xA & Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp & Paper industry.

Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end-to-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements.

This role is contributing to the Process Industries – System 800xA & QCS Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for**
--------------------------------------

* Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end-to-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards.
* Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
* Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications for the Role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M.
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end-to-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks.
* Experience with Quality Control Systems (QCS), DCS integration, industrial process control, and Pulp & Paper applications is preferred, with knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming and industrial automation architectures.
* Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443), automated testing practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent testing certifications are preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional global teams and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.

**More About Us**
-----------------

ABB's Process Industries business serves customers across mining, minerals, metals, cement, pulp & paper, battery manufacturing, food & beverage, and other industrial sectors by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.

Our R&D organization develops next-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, Quality Control Systems (QCS), cloud-enabled digital platforms, and intelligent engineering solutions that help customers optimize manufacturing processes and accelerate digital transformation. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced automation technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial operations.

At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to build world-class automation and quality control solutions while advancing your expertise in industrial software, system validation, digital engineering, and AI-assisted testing. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.

ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea : to create a modern, customer-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.

**Department:** New Product Development (NPD)**Designation:** NPD Engineer**Industry:** Automobile / Automotive Components Manufacturing**Reporting To:** NPD Manager / Operations Head**Experience:** 2–5 Years (as applicable)

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage and coordinate new product development activities from initial customer enquiry to final product approval and mass production. Ensure products are developed as per customer requirements, engineering specifications, quality standards, target costs and delivery schedules.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. New Product Development**

* Handle new product development activities for automotive components.
* Study customer drawings, specifications and technical requirements.
* Review product feasibility, manufacturing processes and technical requirements.
* Coordinate with customers for drawing clarifications and technical discussions.
* Prepare development plans and ensure completion within the committed timeline.
* Coordinate prototype and sample development activities.
* Ensure timely submission of samples to customers for approval.

**B. Engineering & Technical Activities**

* Analyse 2D drawings and 3D models of components.
* Review component dimensions, tolerances, material specifications and surface finish requirements.
* Coordinate with tool rooms for new tool, die, fixture and gauge development.
* Support process development for sheet metal, rubber, plastic and other automotive components, as applicable.
* Identify manufacturing feasibility and process improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate engineering changes and drawing revisions.

**C. APQP & Documentation**

* Prepare and maintain APQP documentation.
* Prepare Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* Coordinate preparation of PFMEA and Control Plans.
* Prepare and maintain PPAP documents.
* Coordinate dimensional inspection reports and material test reports.
* Ensure customer approval before starting mass production.
* Maintain development records and project documentation.

**D. Costing & Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with the purchase and production teams for raw material and process cost estimation.
* Support preparation of new product costing.
* Analyse material consumption, process cycle time and manufacturing costs.
* Work towards achieving target cost without compromising product quality.
* Coordinate with suppliers for tooling, raw material and component development.

**E. Production & Quality Coordination**

* Coordinate with production, quality, purchase and maintenance departments during product development.
* Conduct trial runs and monitor process performance.
* Ensure product quality as per customer specifications.
* Resolve development-related quality issues.
* Support initial production and smooth transfer of new products to regular production.
* Monitor rejection, rework and process improvement activities during development.

**3. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Knowledge of automobile component manufacturing processes.
* Understanding of engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA and SPC.
* Knowledge of 7 QC tools and problem-solving techniques.
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD / SolidWorks / CATIA.
* Knowledge of tooling, fixtures, dies and gauges.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple development projects.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills.

**4. Educational Qualification**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering.
* Experience in automobile component manufacturing is preferred.

**External Coordination:**

* Customers
* Raw Material Suppliers
* Tooling Suppliers
* Component Development Vendors

**Overall Responsibility:**

The NPD Engineer is responsible for successful development of new automotive components, ensuring customer requirements, product quality, cost targets and timely delivery, from initial enquiry through successful mass production.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

JOB DESCRIPTION

MBA – MARKETING / BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER

Industry: Water Treatment, Wastewater Treatment & Recycling Solutions

Educational Qualification: MBA with Basic Engineering degree.

Experience: 3–5 Years & Above Department: Marketing & Business Development Job Type: Full-Time

1. Job Objective

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented MBA Marketing Professional with 3–5 years or more of experience in B2B Marketing and Business Development to promote our range of Water Treatment Plants, Sewage Treatment Plants, Water Recycling Plants, and Water Treatment Equipment & Devices.

The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, establishing strong relationships with industrial consultants, engineering consultants, architects, builders, developers, educational institutions, and water-intensive industries, and generating enquiries and project-based business.

2. Products to Be Marketed

•

Water Treatment Plants (WTP)

•

Sewage Treatment Plants (STP)

•

Water Recycling and Reuse Plants

•

Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP)

•

Industrial Water Treatment Plants

•

Water Treatment Equipment and Devices

•

Water Filtration and Purification Systems

•

Water Pumps, Filters, Membranes and Allied Equipment

•

Complete Water and Wastewater Management Solutions

3. Target Customers & Market Segments

The candidate will be responsible for marketing our products and solutions to the following customer segments:

•

Industrial Consultants: Industrial project consultants, process consultants and water treatment consultants.

•

Engineering Consultants: MEP, civil, mechanical, plumbing and environmental engineering consultants.

•

Architects: Architectural firms, design consultants and project planning consultants.

•

Builders & Developers: Residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure developers.

•

Educational Institutions: Schools, colleges, universities, engineering institutions and campuses.

•

Water-Based Industries: Pharmaceutical, food processing, textile, chemical, manufacturing and other water-intensive industries.

•

Other Sectors: Hospitals, hotels, IT parks, commercial complexes, factories and industrial establishments.

4. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Strategic Marketing & Business Development

•

Develop and implement marketing strategies to promote the company's water treatment products and solutions.

•

Identify potential markets, new customers and business opportunities.

•

Prepare marketing plans to expand the company's presence in industrial, commercial and institutional segments.

•

Develop and maintain a strong database of prospective customers, consultants, architects and project developers.

•

Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual marketing and business development targets.

B. Consultant & Architect Marketing

•

Establish and maintain professional relationships with industrial consultants, engineering consultants, MEP consultants and architects.

•

Conduct regular meetings, presentations and product demonstrations.

•

Promote company products for inclusion in technical specifications, project designs and BOQs.

•

Generate project enquiries through consultant networking and specification-based marketing.

C. Builders, Developers & Institutional Marketing

•

Develop business relationships with builders, real estate developers and infrastructure companies.

•

Identify upcoming residential, commercial and industrial projects requiring WTP, STP and water recycling solutions.

•

Promote products and solutions to educational institutions, universities, hospitals, hotels and commercial establishments.

•

Develop long-term business associations with key decision-makers.

D. Industrial & Corporate Marketing

•

Identify industries requiring water treatment, wastewater treatment and recycling solutions.

•

Approach manufacturing companies and water-intensive industries for potential business.

•

Understand customer requirements and coordinate with the technical team to propose suitable solutions.

•

Generate enquiries for industrial water treatment plants, STPs, ETPs and associated equipment.

E. Lead Generation & Project Follow-up

•

Identify new projects at the planning, design and execution stages.

•

Generate qualified business leads through direct marketing, networking, meetings, references and digital platforms.

•

Coordinate with the technical, estimation and sales teams for proposals and quotations.

•

Follow up on enquiries, proposals, negotiations and order conversion.

•

Maintain a healthy project sales pipeline.

F. Market Research & Reporting

•

Conduct market research and competitor analysis.

•

Identify new market segments, business opportunities and emerging industry requirements.

•

Prepare periodic marketing activity reports and lead generation reports.

•

Maintain customer databases and CRM records.

•

Monitor marketing performance and work towards achieving business objectives.

5. Educational Qualification & Experience

•

MBA in Marketing is mandatory / strongly preferred.

•

Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Marketing, Sales or Business Development.

•

Experience in B2B Marketing, Industrial Marketing, Project Marketing or Institutional Marketing is essential.

•

Experience in the Water Treatment, STP, ETP, Water Recycling, Environmental Engineering or Industrial Equipment industry will be an added advantage.

•

Candidates with experience in marketing technical products, engineering solutions and project-based products are preferred.

6. Essential Skills & Competencies

•

Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

•

Strong business development and networking capabilities.

•

Ability to interact with consultants, architects, builders, developers and industrial decision-makers.

•

Good knowledge of B2B and project-based marketing strategies.

•

Ability to identify potential projects and convert leads into business.

•

Strong client relationship management and follow-up skills.

•

Good analytical, planning and organizational abilities.

•

Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools.

•

Willingness to travel for client meetings, project visits and business development activities.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

1.

Generation of new business enquiries and qualified leads.

2.

Development of new consultant, architect and builder relationships.

3.

Identification of new WTP, STP, ETP and water recycling projects.

4.

Number of client meetings and presentations conducted.

5.

Inclusion of company products in project specifications and BOQs.

6.

Conversion of enquiries into orders and business revenue.

7.

Development of new industrial and institutional customers.

8.

Achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual business development targets.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for an MBA Marketing Professional who is ambitious, proactive, self-motivated and passionate about developing business in the Water and Wastewater Treatment Industry.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to build a strong professional network among consultants, architects, builders, developers, educational institutions and industrial customers, generate new project opportunities, and drive business growth through effective B2B marketing strategies.

Candidates with proven experience in industrial marketing, engineering products, infrastructure projects, environmental solutions and institutional business development will be given preference.

9. How to Apply

Interested candidates with an MBA with basic engineering degree & 3–5 years or more of relevant marketing / business development experience are requested to submit their updated resumes.

Apply Now – Join our team and contribute to sustainable water management and wastewater recycling solutions.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Life insurance
* Paid

**Product Mgr II**

**Do you want to make signing in to Elsevier products simple and secure?**

**Can you build identity and access products together with the product teams who depend on them?**

**About Our Team:-**

Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. We value curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement, and are committed to delivering exceptional experiences for our customers.

  

**About the Role:-**

As a Product Manager II on our team, you will work toward owning the end-to-end value and outcomes of identity and access features, from discovery through to delivery and adoption. You will act as the voice of the customer, using market insight, customer feedback, and data to identify opportunities and define solutions that make sign-in, onboarding and access management easy for customers, while meeting Elsevier's security and compliance bar.

  

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. This role is ideal for a product professional who enjoys combining customer insight, a user-centric approach and data-driven decision-making. You'll partner directly with one or two engineering squads, running discovery through to delivery for your slice of the product, within an overall roadmap and prioritisation set by our Senior Product Manager for Identity and Access. From there, you'll grow into progressively larger scope, working toward owning the full arc of discovery, delivery, and outcomes for your own product area.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

* Own discovery and requirements for several product areas through the product lifecycle — including cross-product functionality (collaborating with other teams within the wider Identity and Access group) and end-to-end release process including collaboration with go-to-market.

* Represent Identity and Access in those product teams. Bring their needs back to the IAM roadmap, and design solutions so that what you build for one product also works for other Elsevier products.
* Collaborate with the other product managers in the Identity and Access team on cross-product functionality, so shared capabilities stay consistent across products.
* Directly support 1-2 engineering squads by answering engineering queries, using user-research insights and customer feedback to drive new product functionality, and collaborating with user experience to ensure the functionality delivered delights users.
* Gather customer insights at the source (customers, institutional admins, Customer Support) and use them, with data and market analysis, to drive product requirements and decisions.
* Own go-to-market and ongoing support for your features, including release plans and stakeholder communications for your product area
* Own how success metrics are defined and calculated, including adoption after release, ensuring they reflect business outcomes.
* Effectively prioritise customer issues, defects, and feature requests for resolution against the ongoing product roadmap.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the identity and access space to inform your product decisions.
  

**Requirements:-**

* Proven Product Management experience, typically with 4-6 years in a product-focused role.
* Hands-on product experience in identity and access, for example authentication, single sign-on (SAML or OpenID Connect), user or customer onboarding, entitlements, or admin tools.
* Experience owning products, features, or significant areas of product functionality. Experience with platform products used by other product teams is a plus.
* Experience working closely with other product managers on shared roadmaps or cross-product features, including resolving conflicting priorities.

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation abilities, including with teams in other time zones.

jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
**DESCRIPTION**

We are seeking highly motivated and curious **AI** engineers **–** college hires – to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of next-generation AI-powered scientific and business applications.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn, design, develop, and test generative **AI and** agentic **AI applications**, intelligent workflows, and solutions powered by large language models (LLMs). You will work alongside experienced engineers, architects, scientists, and product teams to solve real-world problems using modern AI technologies.

You will contribute across the AI application lifecycle, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, model evaluation, application development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.

This role is ideal for recent graduates who have a strong foundation in software engineering and artificial intelligence and are passionate about applying AI technologies to meaningful scientific and business problems.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and enhance AI-powered applications using **Python** and modern AI frameworks.
* Build generative AI applications using large language models such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent models.
* Contribute to the development of agentic **AI applications** and intelligent workflows.
* Learn and apply frameworks such as **Lang Chain** and **Lang Graph** for developing LLM-based applications and AI agents.
* Develop AI agents capable of interacting with tools, APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
* Build and experiment with **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** solutions using enterprise and scientific data.
* Work with vector databases and search technologies such as ChromaDB, FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search, or equivalent technologies.
* Explore local LLM deployment and inference using technologies such as **Ollama**.
* Design and optimize prompts for reliable, accurate, and context-aware AI responses.
* Participate in model and prompt evaluation to measure AI solution quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
* Implement input/output validation, AI guardrails, content filtering, and responsible AI practices.
* Integrate AI applications with REST APIs, databases, microservices, and other enterprise systems.
* Develop unit tests and participate in debugging, code reviews, and application troubleshooting.
* Follow modern software engineering practices including version control, CI/CD, documentation, and Agile development.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate business and scientific problems into technical solutions.
* Stay current with rapidly evolving Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, and software engineering technologies.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology**, or a related technical field.
* Strong programming fundamentals, preferably with **Python**.
* Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-orientated programming, and software engineering concepts.
* Foundational understanding of artificial intelligence,machine learning,generative **AI, and Large Language Models**.
* Academic projects, internships, hackathons, research projects, or personal projects involving AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or software application development.
* Familiarity with prompting and interacting with LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent models.
* Basic understanding of **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** concepts.
* Exposure to AI application frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph**, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks is preferred.
* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, function calling, or autonomous workflows is a plus.
* Familiarity with vector embeddings and vector databases such as ChromaDB, FAISS, Pinecone, or Azure AI Search is a plus.
* Exposure to local LLM technologies such as **Ollama** is a plus.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, databases, and client-server application development.
* Familiarity with **Git** and modern software development practices.
* Understanding of software testing, debugging, and problem-solving techniques.
* Awareness of responsible AI concepts such as AI safety, privacy, security, guardrails, and output validation.
* Strong analytical thinking and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and Agile development environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Internship, academic, research, or project experience developing Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
* Projects demonstrating the use of **LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, AI agents, or multi-agent workflows**.
* Experience building applications that integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, documents, or external tools.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Exposure to Docker, containers, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, or DevOps practices.
* Participation in AI/ML hackathons, open-source projects, technical competitions, research publications, or relevant certifications.
* Experience developing and deploying a working AI application as part of an academic or personal project.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **0–2 years of relevant experience.**
* Fresh graduates with strong academic, internship, research, hackathon, or project experience are encouraged to apply.
* Demonstrated interest in **Generative AI, Large Language Models, Agentic AI, and modern software engineering**.
* Experience through coursework, internships, academic projects, research, or personal projects will be considered relevant.

**WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED**

* Curiosity and enthusiasm for solving problems using emerging AI technologies.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and a willingness to write high-quality, maintainable code.
* Ability to quickly learn new frameworks, models, and development tools.
* A practical, experimentation-driven approach to evaluating AI solutions.
* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Passion for applying technology to scientific and business challenges that support Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Mission of enabling our customers to make the world **healthier, cleaner and safer**.

Job Description

We are hiring an experienced SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) Functional Consultant with strong hands-on configuration and implementation experience in both modules.

The ideal candidate should have completed at least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation and possess strong expertise in manufacturing, production planning, quality management and cross-functional integration.

Mandatory Skills

* Experience in QM inspection processes, results recording, usage decisions and quality notifications.
* Experience with SAP BTP product development.
* Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA simplification items and SAP Fiori applications.
* Strong understanding of PP/QM integration with MM, SD, PM and FI/CO.
* Experience with SAP Activate methodology.

**SAP Quality Management (QM)**

* Manage inspection lots, results recording, defects recording and usage decisions.
* Configure quality notifications, vendor complaints, customer complaints and follow-up actions.

**Implementation and Integration**

* Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and fit-gap analysis.
* Prepare solution design documents, functional specifications and configuration documents.
* Manage integration with SAP MM, SD, PM, FI/CO and EWM/WM.
* Support master data migration using S/4HANA Migration Cockpit.
* Collaborate with technical teams on RICEFW developments.
* Drive SIT, UAT, defect resolution and business sign-off.
* Support end-user training, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities.
* Configure and demonstrate relevant SAP Fiori applications.

Good-to-Have Skills

* SAP Digital Manufacturing (DM), SAP ME/MII or MES integration.
* Embedded SAP PP/DS or advanced planning experience.
* Statistical Process Control (SPC) and quality analytics.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, food and beverage or chemical industries.
* Knowledge of GMP, audit trails and electronic signature requirements.
* Industry exposure to automotive, CPG, industrial manufacturing or textiles.
* SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing or Quality Management certification.
* Basic ABAP debugging knowledge.

Educational Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent degree.
* MBA in Operations or manufacturing industry experience is an added advantage.

Additional Requirements

* Strong communication and client-facing skills.
* Ability to independently manage a functional module.
* Willingness to travel for client engagements and onsite assignments.

Global Commercial Leader - IDS

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to manage and own global commercial enablement initiatives and digital tools that support business growth and commercial excellence. You will collaborate closely with global, regional, and cross-functional stakeholders to enhance sales effectiveness, improve commercial processes, and accelerate digital transformation across the organization. You will also play a key role in developing training programs, optimizing bid and proposal processes, improving commercial reporting, and supporting pricing strategies for digital and software offerings.

**This role is contributing to the Automation Process Industries Digital (AUPI) business globally. Main stakeholders include Commercial Enablement, Digital, Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Finance, and Bid & Proposal teams.**

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Managing sales enablement initiatives, including training programs, webinars, learning sessions, and development of commercial enablement content and tools.
* Standardizing and continuously improving bid and proposal processes, performance metrics, and adoption of AI-enabled proposal solutions.
* Supporting digital opportunity reporting, performance analytics, recurring revenue tracking, and subscription business management through effective data governance and collaboration.
* Maintaining and enhancing pricing methodologies, subscription pricing tools, and long-term digital growth planning in alignment with ABB policies and commercial objectives.

**Our team dynamics**

You will join a collaborative, globally diverse team, where you will have the opportunity to help shape commercial transformation initiatives, work with digital technologies, and contribute to ABB's growth strategy.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You are highly skilled in commercial operations, sales enablement, pricing management, business analytics, and digital transformation within a B2B environment.
* You have 10+ years of experience in commercial roles, pricing, sales operations, commercial excellence, or related functions in a matrixed and multi-regional organization.
* You possess advanced knowledge of CRM platforms (Salesforce/SFDC), Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions.
* You are focused on stakeholder collaboration, project management, process improvement, and promoting adoption of digital and AI-enabled solutions.

**What's in it for you?**

* Work in a global role with broad exposure across regions, business lines, and leadership teams.
* Support digital transformation and commercial excellence initiatives that impact business performance.
* Collaborate with industry experts and cross-functional teams in a highly innovative environment.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging technologies and AI-enabled solutions within commercial operations.
