**More about us**

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry knowledge coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

jobs.description:
Job Description | Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Research & Development
  
  
**Role at a glance**
Mosaic Wellness is hiring an Assistant Manager to own gummy and nutraceutical development, from bench formulation to commercial launch.
  
  
**Position**
Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals
**Function**
Research & Development (New Product Development)
**Location**
Thane West, Mumbai
**Reports to**
Head of R&D
**Experience**
6–10 years in nutraceutical R&D, including hands-on gummy development
**Education**
M.Sc. (Science) or M.Tech in a relevant discipline
**Travel**
Regular visits to CDMO and supplier sites across India
**Employment**
Full-time
  
  
**About Mosaic Wellness**
Mosaic Wellness is a Mumbai-based, digital-first health and wellness company. Its consumer brands, including Man Matters, Be Bodywise and Little Joys, serve men’s, women’s and children’s health and nutrition needs.
  
  
Our R&D team develops science-led nutraceuticals, functional foods and personal care products with manufacturing partners across India. Gummies are a key format across the portfolio.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will own gummy and nutraceutical products end to end: formulation on the bench, scale-up at CDMOs, and a stable, compliant commercial launch.
  
  
The role solves the hard problems of the gummy format: high active loads, taste masking, sugar reduction, texture and shelf-life stability. You will be R&D’s point person for this category across brands, working closely with Brand, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement and manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Formulation and product development**

* Develop gummies across gelling systems (gelatin, pectin, carrageenan, agar, starch), including vegan, sugar-free and reduced-sugar variants.
* Formulate with demanding actives: vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics, prebiotic fibres and other high-load ingredients.
* Engineer taste and texture through bitterness masking, flavour and acid profiling, chew optimisation, colour stability, sanding and oil coating.
* Design out gummy failure modes: sweating, stickiness, crystallisation, syneresis, heat deformation, browning and active degradation.
* Extend expertise to other formats as needed: powders and sachets, tablets, capsules, effervescents and chewables.

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  

* Run bench trials, Design of Experiments (DoE) and sensory evaluations, with complete lab records.

**Process development, scale-up and tech transfer**

* Define critical process parameters: cook temperature and solids (°Brix), deposit pH and temperature, deposit weight, curing conditions and final water activity.
* Lead pilot, scale-up and first commercial batches on starch mogul and starchless depositing lines at CDMO sites.
* Prepare tech-transfer packages: formula, bill of materials, process flow, Master Formula Record inputs and specifications.
* Troubleshoot weight variation, tailing, mould sticking and yield loss to deliver right-first-time commercialisation.

**Stability, quality and analytics**

* Design accelerated and real-time stability studies under ICH-aligned conditions (including Zone IVb, 30 °C/75% RH) to set overages and shelf life.
* Write raw material, packaging and finished-goods specifications; review analytical data with in-house teams and NABL-accredited labs.
* Select packaging for moisture and oxygen protection, backed by water-activity and moisture-sorption data.
* Lead root-cause analysis and CAPA for deviations, out-of-specification results and consumer complaints.

**Regulatory and documentation**

* Keep formulations and labels compliant with FSSAI’s Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations (2022), Labelling and Display Regulations (2020) and AYUSH norms where relevant.
* Check ingredient permissibility, RDA-based limits and label claims; prepare technical dossiers, including for Non-Specified Food approvals.
* Support export-market requirements (e.g., GCC, US 21 CFR) with Regulatory Affairs.

**Ingredients, partners and cost**

* Scout and qualify new ingredients, technologies and suppliers, and develop alternate sources for supply resilience.
* Assess CDMO capability and build strong technical partnerships with manufacturing and ingredient partners.
* Hit COGS targets through formulation and process value engineering, without compromising efficacy or sensory quality.

**Collaboration and team**

* Translate brand and consumer briefs into technical briefs, and deliver launches on the NPD calendar with cross-functional teams.
* Guide and mentor junior scientists, and share learnings across R&D.
* Track global gummy and delivery-format trends, and contribute to patents and scientific publications.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Education**
**One Of The Following**

* M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Pharmaceutical Technology

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  
**Experience**

* 6–10 years in R&D or NPD for nutraceuticals, health supplements or functional foods, at a consumer brand, nutraceutical company or CDMO.
* At least 3 years of hands-on gummy development, with products taken from concept to commercial launch.
* Scale-up experience on mogul or starchless depositing lines, in-house or at a CDMO.
* A track record of stability-led formulation, setting overages and shelf life for vitamins, botanicals or probiotics.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of hydrocolloid and sugar/polyol science: gelation, pH and calcium sensitivity, glass transition, crystallisation and water activity.
* Confident with analytical data: assay and HPLC results, moisture and water activity, texture analysis and microbiology.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI nutraceutical and labelling regulations, GMP and HACCP.
* Structured experimentation (DoE), clear technical documentation and crisp reporting.
* Able to run several projects, CDMOs and stakeholders in parallel.

**Good to have**

* Experience with tablets, capsules, softgels, powders or effervescents alongside gummies.
* Probiotic, high-fibre, high-load or centre-filled gummy development.
* Work with microencapsulated actives or other novel delivery formats.
* Exposure to export regulations: US 21 CFR 111, GCC (GSO) or EU.
* Experience in a D2C or fast-growing consumer health company.
* Patents or peer-reviewed publications.
* Statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP or Design-Expert.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**
Within a year, gummies are a dependable, scalable platform for Mosaic’s brands.
  
  

* Gummy and nutraceutical launches delivered on the NPD calendar, scaled up right first time at CDMOs.
* Every launched SKU meets label claim through shelf life, backed by robust stability data.
* Measurable COGS savings from value engineering on existing products.
* A stronger gummy platform: documented process windows, qualified alternate suppliers and fewer quality complaints.

**Why join**
You get real ownership, scientific depth and room to grow.
  
  

* Own a key format end to end, with direct influence on what reaches consumers.
* Work in a lean, decentralised R&D team where scientists own their projects and decisions sit close to the bench.
* Grow beyond gummies into nutraceuticals, functional foods and novel delivery technologies.
* Build your scientific profile through patents and publications, alongside leaders with deep global CPG experience.

jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Operating from our manufacturing facility at Himalayan Food Park in Kashipur with a daily production capacity of up to 5,00,000 bars, we partner with leading FMCG and nutrition brands to deliver products from concept to shelf.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on **Production Manager** to oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations at our Kashipur plant. You will lead daily shop-floor production across our sheet-and-cut, cold extrusion, baking, enrobing, and packaging lines while ensuring strict adherence to FSSAI, cGMP, and FSSC 22000 food safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Execution:** Plan, schedule, and execute daily and monthly production targets across multiple bar-manufacturing lines (30g–150g SKUs) to ensure on-time order fulfillment.
* **Process & Line Management:** Supervise specialized food processing operations including slab/sheet-and-cut, low-pressure cold extrusion, baking, chocolate/compound enrobing, and primary/secondary automated packaging.
* **Quality & Food Safety Compliance:** Enforce cGMP, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and FSSAI guidelines on the shop floor. Oversee critical control points including inline metal detection and check-weighing systems.
* **Yield Optimization & Waste Reduction:** Monitor raw material consumption, batch yields, and rework; implement lean manufacturing practices to minimize wastage and downtime.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, train, and manage shift supervisors, machine operators, and floor workers; oversee shift scheduling, attendance, and shop-floor discipline.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance (QA/QC), R&D (for new product trials and tech transfers), Maintenance, and Supply Chain/Stores teams to resolve bottlenecks smoothly.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Maintain accurate daily production logs, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics, batch manufacturing records (BMR), and audit documentation for client and regulatory inspections.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.

OB DESCRIPTIONProject Manager – Nutraceutical Industry

**Company:** Sunshine Corporation (Brand: NoCheat) – Jolly Group of Companies  
**Location:** Rajkot, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Department:** Nutraceutical / FMCG  
**Experience:** 5+ Years Preferred  
**Salary:** No Bar for the Right Candidate  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

About the Company

Jolly Group of Companies is a diversified business group operating across multiple sectors, including textiles, real estate, oil recycling, insurance, FMCG, and nutraceuticals.

Under our brand **NoCheat**, we are expanding our nutraceutical business with innovative health, wellness, sports nutrition, beauty nutrition, and kids' nutrition products.

We are looking for an experienced **Nutraceutical Project Manager** to lead and manage product development projects from concept to successful commercial launch.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Project Planning & Management**

* Plan, execute, and monitor nutraceutical product development projects.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, resources, and deliverables.
* Coordinate multiple product launches simultaneously.
* Ensure timely completion of projects.

**2. Product Development & R&D Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D teams on product formulations and development.
* Coordinate development of powders, gummies, liquids, premixes, and other nutraceutical products.
* Oversee product trials, sampling, stability testing, and formulation approvals.
* Ensure product quality, effectiveness, and market suitability.

**3. Manufacturing & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with third-party manufacturers and contract manufacturing partners.
* Manage vendor selection, raw material sourcing, and packaging development.
* Monitor production schedules, manufacturing trials, and commercial batches.
* Ensure manufacturing quality and timely product delivery.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure products comply with applicable FSSAI regulations and other relevant standards.
* Coordinate product documentation, testing, certifications, and label approvals.
* Work with QA/QC teams to maintain product quality and safety.
* Ensure proper regulatory documentation before product launch.

**5. Product Launch & Commercialization**

* Manage end-to-end product commercialization.
* Coordinate with marketing, branding, packaging, purchase, and sales teams.
* Monitor packaging development, costing, and production readiness.
* Ensure successful product launches within approved timelines.

**6. Budget & Cost Management**

* Prepare and monitor project budgets.
* Control formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and development costs.
* Negotiate with suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.

**7. Team Management & Reporting**

* Lead cross-functional teams, including R&D, Purchase, QA/QC, Production, and Marketing.
* Conduct regular project review meetings.
* Prepare project progress reports for senior management and the Managing Director.
* Identify project risks and implement corrective actions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Food Technology, Nutraceutical Science, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related field.
* MBA or Project Management certification will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, health supplements, or FMCG product development.
* Experience handling multiple product development and launch projects.
* Strong understanding of formulation development, manufacturing processes, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience working with third-party manufacturers.

Key Skills

* Project Management & Execution
* Nutraceutical Product Development
* R&D and Manufacturing Coordination
* FSSAI & Regulatory Knowledge
* Vendor & Supplier Management
* Product Launch Management
* Budgeting & Cost Optimization
* Leadership & Team Coordination
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making
* Strong Communication & Reporting

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a result-oriented professional who can independently manage nutraceutical projects from **product concept, formulation, sampling, testing, manufacturing, and packaging to final market launch**.

Candidates with experience in sports nutrition, kids' nutrition, beauty nutrition, and daily health supplements will be preferred.

Benefits

* Opportunity to work on a growing nutraceutical brand.

* Long-term career growth opportunities.

**Service Manager Job Description**

**1. Service Management**

* Develop and implement service policies, procedures, and standards to ensure consistency and efficiency
* Lead and supervise service technicians and service coordinator.
* Allocate service calls, installations, and preventive maintenance jobs(CMC).
* Monitor daily service activities, productivity, and discipline.
* Conduct technical training, safety training, and performance reviews.
* Ensure technicians follow SOPs, safety norms, and documentation standards.

**2. ERP Management (End-to-End)**

* Collect data for raising ticket, Designation, Phone number, Email ID, Machine Model, Serial Number, Complaint Description, Photo/ Video.
* Raise quotation based on the approval/ payment conformation, allot service technician as per the availability, competency, location and criticality of service.
* Ensure **job cards are raised accurately** for all service calls from Customer, Project team, and Sales team. (installation, breakdown, PM, AMC/CMC).
* Review job card details including complaint description, parts used, labour, travel, and service status.
* Ensure service reports are attached with job card.

**3. Coordination & Service Scheduling**

* Work closely with the **Service Coordinator** to:
* Receive service requests and log complaints.
* Schedule technicians and site visits.
* Track job status and escalation.

**4. Spare Parts & Warranty Control**

* Approve spare parts usage as per warranty/AMC/chargeable conditions.
* Monitor spare consumption against job cards.
* Ensure defective parts are returned and handed over properly to concern department.
* Coordinate with stores for inventory reconciliation.

**5. Billing & Payment Coordination (PI to Payment)**

* Review & Approve the Performa invoice and ensure all commercial documentation was completed.
* Verify completed job cards for **billing eligibility** (Warranty, AMC/CMC, out-of-warranty calls).
* Ensure timely submission of approved Performa Invoice to accounts for invoicing.
* Coordinate with accounts and service coordinator to track invoices.
* Follow up with customers for payment realization and resolve service-related billing queries.
* Ensure closure of service tickets only after payment confirmation.

\*

**6. Customer Relationship & Escalation Handling**

* Act as escalation point for service-related customer issues.
* Ensure professional communication with hospitals.
* Review customer feedback and take corrective actions.

**7. Compliance, Quality & Documentation**

* Maintain service reports, installation certificates, and AMC logs.
* Support audits and regulatory inspections related to service operations.

**8. Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Require to share Weekly Service Call Report & Weekly Installation Report to MD.
* Analyse repeat complaints, response time, closure efficiency on Monthly Service Call Report & Monthly Installation Report.
* Require to share Monthly Service Call Report & Monthly Installation Report to MD after review.
* Identify recurring technical issues and provide feedback to R&D and production teams.
* Improve service efficiency, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

Language Preferences: English, Hindi & Tamil

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

* total work: 10 years (Preferred)

Inside Sales Executive – FMCG / Food & Beverage

**Location:** Taramani Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Industry:** FMCG / Food & Beverage / Food Processing / Nutraceuticals / Consumer Products

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and target-oriented **Inside Sales Executive** to generate business opportunities, engage prospective clients and support revenue growth through outbound calls, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach and inbound enquiry management.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers across the FMCG, food and beverage, nutraceutical, food processing and consumer products industries and introducing them to our company's services.

The role involves understanding customer requirements, explaining our service offerings, qualifying leads, scheduling meetings and nurturing prospects throughout the sales cycle.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, confidence in making outbound calls, strong follow-up abilities and an interest in the food, FMCG and consumer products industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Inside Sales & Lead Conversion**

* Handle inbound business enquiries received through the company website, email, LinkedIn and other marketing channels.
* Conduct outbound calls to prospective B2B clients.
* Introduce company services and identify potential business opportunities.
* Explain services related to food product development, formulation, R&D, pilot manufacturing, contract manufacturing and commercialization.
* Understand customer requirements and identify suitable service offerings.
* Convert enquiries into qualified sales opportunities.
* Nurture prospects through regular calls, emails and follow-ups.
* Work towards achieving monthly sales and conversion targets.

**2. Lead Generation & Prospecting**

* Identify potential customers in the FMCG, food and beverage, nutraceutical and food processing industries.

* Identify relevant decision-makers such as:

* Product Development Managers
* Procurement Managers
* Business Development Heads
* Production and Operations Managers
* Conduct initial conversations to understand client requirements.
* Qualify prospects based on project requirements, budget, business potential and timelines.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective customers.

* Explain company capabilities, services and business solutions to potential customers.
* Understand customer requirements related to new product development, food formulation, product improvement and manufacturing.
* Follow up with prospects regarding enquiries, proposals, quotations and ongoing discussions.
* Schedule meetings between prospective clients and the business development or technical teams.
* Maintain professional relationships with prospects and existing customers.
* Ensure timely responses to customer enquiries.
* Re-engage inactive leads and follow up on previously contacted prospects.

* Food R&D and innovation.
* Functional food and beverage development.
* Nutraceutical and health product development.
* Pilot-scale product development.
* Contract manufacturing and private-label solutions.
* Food testing and quality-related services.
* Food regulatory and compliance support.
* Ingredient sourcing and product commercialization.

The candidate should be able to communicate the basic value proposition of these services and coordinate with technical teams for detailed discussions.

**5. Sales Coordination & Proposal Support**

* Coordinate with business development, R&D, formulation and technical teams.
* Understand client project requirements and communicate them internally.
* Assist in preparing basic proposals, quotations and presentations.
* Schedule technical discussions and client meetings.
* Follow up on proposals and quotations to move prospects towards conversion.
* Maintain communication with clients throughout the sales process.
* Support smooth client onboarding after successful conversion.

**6. CRM & Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, emails, follow-ups and sales opportunities.
* Update CRM systems with prospect details and communication history.
* Track lead status, enquiry sources, meeting schedules and conversions.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales activity reports.
* Monitor call performance, lead qualification and conversion rates.
* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.
* Share regular sales updates with the reporting manager.

**Target Client Segments**

The candidate will engage with prospective clients from:

* Food and beverage manufacturers.
* Packaged food companies.
* Beverage and functional drink brands.
* Dairy and dairy-based product manufacturers.
* Snacks, bakery and confectionery companies.
* Ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook food brands.

* Health and wellness startups.

* Food processing companies.

**Required Skills**

* Confidence in making outbound calls and handling customer conversations.
* Strong inside sales and lead generation capabilities.

* Ability to understand customer requirements and qualify business leads.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Quality
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Assistant Manager Quality Assurance (QA/QC)**
-----------------------------------------------

**Location:** Silvassa

**Department:** Quality Control (QC)

**Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E.

**Experience:** 710 Years

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Assistant Manager Quality Assurance to lead and manage Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities across manufacturing operations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, process compliance, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality management and food safety standards, including ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and oversee all Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities across manufacturing operations.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and applicable quality and food safety standards.
* Handle customer and supplier quality requirements, complaints, and quality-related concerns.
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and 8D problem-solving activities.
* Implement and monitor FMEA, the 7 QC Tools, and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Plan and conduct internal audits, customer audits, supplier audits, and product traceability audits.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
* Monitor and ensure effective implementation of Control Plans, PRP, OPRP, CCP, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Ensure proper functional testing, inspection, and validation of products and processes.
* Maintain quality documentation, inspection reports, test records, SOPs, and audit-related documents.
* Monitor product quality at incoming, in-process, and final inspection stages.
* Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, R&D, and other departments to resolve quality-related issues.
* Ensure proper utilization, calibration, and maintenance of laboratory testing equipment.
* Develop and implement quality improvement plans to reduce rejection, customer complaints, and process deviations.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000 standards.
* Hands-on experience in RCA, CAPA, 8D, and FMEA.
* Good understanding of the 7 QC Tools and statistical quality control.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma.
* Understanding of PRP, OPRP, CCP, Control Plans, and SPC.
* Experience in internal audits, customer audits, and supplier audits.
* Knowledge of laboratory testing equipment and functional testing procedures.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**
------------------------

**Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E. in a relevant technical discipline.

**Experience:** 710 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. You will become a part of India’s proudest legacy, a brand that is celebrated by **130 million Indians** and is now taking over the world with its manufacturing superpower.

**Audits and Inspections**: The manager prepares for and manages internal and external audits by regulatory bodies or third-party certifiers. They ensure all facilities, processes, and documentation are inspection-ready at all times.

**Regulatory Intelligence and Risk Management**: They proactively monitor the global regulatory landscape, including new and proposed legislation, guidelines, and industry trends. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
About Company

House of Spices is a leading South Asian Food manufacturer and distributor in North America (USA & Canada) and has been delivering pure and quality products for over 50 years with 11 distribution centers throughout North America. We have our own brands and have exclusivity for distributing our partner brands in US / Canada. Our vision is to bring our culture alive through the celebration of authentic ethnic food, flavor and families. Our mission is to provide consumers easy access to all authentic ethnic food and flavors across the North American marketplace with a will to win. Visit www.hosindia.com to know more.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective:

The Supplier QA Executive will be primarily responsible for on-site production witnessing and supplier quality assurance for HOS products manufactured at supplier/co-packer facilities across South India.

The key responsibility is to ensure that every witnessed production is carried out as per approved HOS product specifications, formulations, process parameters, food-safety requirements, SOPs, GMP/GHP, sanitation requirements and applicable US FDA/FSMA requirements.

The position will have a strong shop-floor presence and will be responsible for identifying deviations during production, immediately communicating risks, ensuring containment, supporting root-cause analysis (RCA) and verifying effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

This is primarily a field-based supplier QA role, not a documentation-focused position.

**Base Location: Vadodara**

Key Responsibilities

**Supplier Production Witnessing & Process Compliance**

* Regularly visit assigned suppliers and witness production to ensure products are manufactured as per approved HOS specifications, formulations, process parameters, SOPs, quality standards and applicable food-safety requirements. Verify actual production conditions and process controls rather than relying only on supplier documentation.

**Raw Material, Formulation & Product Specification Compliance**

* Verify the use of approved raw materials, ingredients and packaging materials and ensure formulation, processing, product characteristics, net weight and finished-product requirements comply with approved HOS specifications. Identify and escalate any unauthorized changes or deviations.

**Critical Process & Food Safety Control Verification**

* Verify implementation and monitoring of HACCP/Preventive Controls, CCPs, critical process parameters and other food-safety controls during production, with particular focus on
  **Frozen RTE and Rice processing**
  .

**Ready to eat products Quality Assurance:**

* Provide strong on-site quality oversight for Frozen RTE and Rice products, including cooking, cooling, freezing, hygiene, cross-contamination controls, temperature controls, foreign-material controls, destoning, grading, sortex, admixture, varietal authenticity and other product-specific requirements.

**GMP, Hygiene, Sanitation & Plant Verification**

* Conduct regular physical verification of supplier facilities for GMP/GHP, personnel hygiene, housekeeping, cleaning and sanitation, pest control, allergen control, foreign-material prevention, equipment condition, calibration and other prerequisite programs.

**Supplier Quality & Food Safety Audits**

* Conduct and support supplier/co-packer assessments and audits against HOS requirements, approved specifications, applicable regulatory requirements, GMP, HACCP/Preventive Controls, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, BRC/customer requirements and other applicable standards.

**Deviation, Non-Conformance & Containment Management**

* Identify quality and food-safety deviations during production, ensure appropriate immediate containment and segregation of affected material, determine the scope of impact and communicate significant issues to the QA Manager before product release or shipment.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Lead or support supplier investigations for production deviations, complaints and non-conformances and ensure effective RCA using appropriate tools such as
  **5 Why, Fishbone and process analysis**
  . Challenge incomplete or unsupported root causes and ensure the RCA addresses the actual cause of failure.

**CAPA Implementation & Effectiveness Verification**

* Review supplier CAPA, verify implementation at the supplier site and ensure corrective and preventive actions address the identified root cause. CAPA shall be closed only after objective evidence and, where required, follow-up production witnessing demonstrate effectiveness and prevention of recurrence.

**Complaint, Traceability & Supplier Performance Management**

* Support investigation of customer and internal complaints, verify batch/lot traceability, mock recalls, sample retention and relevant supplier records, and monitor supplier performance to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities

**Reporting, Follow-Up & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare timely supplier visit and production-witnessing reports, document observations and objective evidence, track open actions and CAPA, follow up with suppliers until effective closure, and identify opportunities to improve supplier processes, quality performance and food-safety controls.

Travel

1. Travel is mandatory for this Job Profile

Required Education and Experience

1. A master’s or bachelor’s degree in food science/food technology or equivalent qualification.
2. Should have handled 3P operations
3. Knowledge of lab technique of analyzing different food product.
4. Good in MS word, excel, and power point.
5. Good organoleptic senses for product and sensory evaluation.
6. Lead Auditor (Any GFSI Scheme Certified PCQI Personnel Preferred.

**Preferred Knowledge**

1. Knowledge of lab technique and prior training in fundamental quality assurance technology.
2. Basic Knowledge of Quality Assurance; GFSI and Regulatory (US FDA); FSMA and other Regulatory standards.
3. Good Technical skills.
4. Good communication skills.
5. Aptitude in problem-solving.
6. Working with start-up environment

Competencies

1. Teamwork.
2. Communication.
3. Consultation.
4. Ethical Practice
5. Problem Solving

jobs.description:
**About InspireXT**

InspireXT is on a mission to become the world's most trusted supply chain consulting partner, and to create a company where our clients, our people and our partners flourish. We have lofty ambitions in an exciting market, where sustainability, efficiency, AI & technology enablement are driving bold collaborations in pursuit of customer excellence and profitable growth.

The foundation is laid, momentum is building, and we now are looking for talented team players who share our values and want to make a meaningful difference and be part of shaping the next chapter. We were born in the UK 7 years ago, and we now have colleagues in 4 markets who are delivering Customer Centric Supply Chain solutions to our clients, bringing together the latest offerings from our various Alliance partners like Databricks, Oracle, Salesforce, Litmus and Specright as well as innovative AI & technology solutions that deliver rapid time to value.

**WHY**
**InspireXT**
**?**



Because transformation, at its best, is human. You’ll work with people who care deeply about what they do, who believe in trust before transactions, and who want to leave every client stronger than they found them. We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. If that sounds like you – we’d love to hear from you. Apply to be part of our growth story.

Note - we are an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering diversity & growth for all. We welcome applications from traditional and unusual backgrounds and also are happy to discuss any specific accommodations required in the recruitment process to help you shine.
  

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

- EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
- EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
- EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
- EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
- EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
- REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.

* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

- FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
- FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
- Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
- FDA food contact substance requirements.
- Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
- Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.
Business Process & Stakeholder Management
  

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

- Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
- Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
- Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
- Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
- Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
- Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.
- Data migration mapping and specification governance inputs.
- UAT scena

jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow
* You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations
* Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW
* You will get above-market remuneration
* We provide a safe space for all
* At CEEW, your life is your example for others

**Designation offered**
  
Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

**Location**
  
New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

### **Responsibilities and Duties**

**Strategy**

* Co-evolve the strategy for the programme’s political economy work, building on existing in-house thinking, the political economy landscape across food systems reform, our skillset and niche, the evolving sectoral narrative, and emerging government priorities.
* Work closely with the team to bring alignment within the team on the strategy.
* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.
* Map stakeholders, interests, and power structures across government, political leadership, and public institutions relevant to food systems reform, ensuring alignment and collaborative execution.
* Lead research in the programme area as a principal investigator. Guide and provide relevant inputs to the wider research agenda.
* Assess and improve existing methodologies and frameworks employed by SFS relevant to political economy analysis, and build institutional capacity on such methodologies.
* Keep a tab on policy and political developments in agriculture and food systems.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to write coherently and concisely: emails, opinion pieces, policy briefs, and reports

### **Leadership and Mentoring**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the programme. Ideate new research concepts with team members, develop project proposals and budgets, build relationships with donors that align with the institution’s interests, secure resources for building and expanding the work programme, deliver high-quality, timely outputs, engage with sectoral stakeholders, strive for impact, and develop CEEW’s thought leadership.
* Build and lead your team. Hone the team members to the best of their abilities. Stretch and strive and set leadership by initiative.
* Lead the strategic outreach of the programme. Lead external meetings, conferences, and seminars with government, political leadership, and public institutions, and be the face of CEEW in your programme area, while also creating platforms for your team for public engagement.
* Strategise the communication and outreach of research outputs along with the outreach team.
* Build strong relationships based on trust and credibility with key policymakers, political leadership, and sector stakeholders.

### **Selection Criteria and Key Skills**

* **Education:** PhD or Master’s degree in public policy/political science/international relations/ agriculture/rural development/food systems/public affairs/mass communication/journalism or any other relevant field relevant to food systems transformation.

### **Professional experience**

* At least 10 years of relevant experience in undertaking and leading research, policy engagement, and project management, in one or more of the following areas. Candidates who have prior experience in the following fields will be given a strong preference:
  + Political economy and public policy
  + Working in or with governments, political leadership, or public institutions
  + Agriculture, rural development, or food systems
  + Public affairs, strategic communications, or journalism, with an understanding of how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making
* Ability to navigate diverse stakeholders and strategise systems-level change
* Proven track record in building relationships and coalitions with government, political leadership, and public institutions
* Experience in designing and leading interdisciplinary and inter-programmatic work
* Strong track record of team management and project management, including timely delivery of outputs
* Have demonstrated thought leadership in the areas relevant to the ToR

### **Skills and Competencies**

* Curiosity and an ability to think creatively.
* Willingness to learn new research and project management skills.
* Willingness to travel for field visits and stakeholder interviews (if needed).
* Ability to effectively work in a team while driving research with minimum assistance, when time demands independently.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

The role includes ensuring complete compliance with **NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations**, and other applicable standards from **raw material inward to finished goods dispatch**, including APEDA TraceNet operations, Transaction Certificate (TC) management, batch traceability, production compliance, documentation, and certification audits.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Sc. Agriculture / M.Sc. Agriculture
* B.Tech Food Technology / M.Sc. Food Science
* Biotechnology / Microbiology
* Quality Assurance or equivalent qualification
* Additional certification in Organic Standards, HACCP, ISO 22000, Food Safety, or Internal Auditor will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in organic food processing, certification, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience in certified organic food manufacturing or processing units is mandatory.
* Experience in export-oriented food manufacturing will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Organic Certification Management**

* Ensure compliance with NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations, and customer-specific organic requirements.
* Coordinate with certification agencies for inspections, surveillance audits, renewals, and certification updates.
* Maintain certification validity and statutory compliance.

**2. Raw Material (Inward) Compliance**

* Verify supplier Organic Scope Certificates and Transaction Certificates (TCs).
* Ensure only approved certified organic raw materials are received.
* Verify inward documentation, lot details, and traceability records.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores for compliant inward operations.

**3. Production & Processing Compliance**

* Monitor manufacturing activities as per organic certification requirements.
* Create and maintain production batches in ERP and traceability systems.
* Verify Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packing Records (BPR).
* Monitor material consumption, production yields, wastage, and reconciliation.
* Ensure segregation of organic, in-conversion, and conventional materials.
* Verify cleaning and changeover records before production.

**4. Batch Creation & Traceability**

* Create production batches with complete lot traceability.
* Maintain batch-wise inward, production, processing, and packing records.
* Ensure complete forward and backward traceability.
* Conduct mass balance verification and stock reconciliation.

**5. Finished Goods Compliance**

* Verify finished product labeling as per organic regulations.
* Ensure packaging materials comply with certification requirements.
* Approve finished goods for dispatch after compliance verification.
* Maintain finished goods inventory records.

**6. Transaction Certificate (TC) Management**

* Generate inward and outward Transaction Certificates.
* Manage APEDA TraceNet transactions.
* Coordinate with certification bodies for TC issuance.
* Ensure timely documentation for domestic and export consignments.

**7. Documentation & Record Management**

* Maintain certification documents and statutory records.
* Manage:
* Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)
* Batch Packing Records (BPR)
* Stock Registers
* Processing Records
* Yield Reports
* Traceability Records
* Cleaning & Sanitation Records
* Dispatch Documentation
* Maintain electronic and physical documentation as per document control procedures.

**8. Audit & Compliance Management**

* Coordinate internal, customer, and certification audits.
* Prepare audit documentation.
* Address non-conformities and implement CAPA.
* Conduct internal compliance inspections.
* Ensure continuous audit readiness.

**9. Warehouse & Inventory Compliance**

* Ensure proper segregation and identification of organic inventory.
* Verify warehouse compliance with certification requirements.
* Conduct stock verification and inventory reconciliation.
* Monitor storage conditions and product integrity.

**10. Cross Functional Coordination**

Coordinate closely with:

* Procurement
* Production
* Quality Assurance
* Warehouse
* Sales & Exports
* Dispatch & Logistics
* Regulatory Affairs

Support new product approvals, certification requirements, employee training, and customer audits.

**Required Knowledge**

* NPOP Organic Standards
* USDA NOP Organic Regulations
* EU Organic Regulations
* APEDA TraceNet
* Transaction Certificate (TC) Management
* Organic Traceability Systems
* ERP Batch Management
* HACCP
* GMP & GHP
* ISO 22000
* FSSAI Regulations
* Food Safety Management Systems
* Documentation Control
* Internal Audit Procedures

**Technical Skills**

* ERP (SAP / ERPNext / Oracle / Microsoft Dynamics / Tally ERP or equivalent)
* Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
* MS Word
* PowerPoint

* Documentation Management

**Key Competencies**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage certification audits independently.

A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR

InspireXT is on a mission to become the world's most trusted supply chain consulting partner, and to create a company where our clients, our people and our partners flourish. We have lofty ambitions in an exciting market, where sustainability, efficiency, AI & technology enablement are driving bold collaborations in pursuit of customer excellence and profitable growth.

**WHY** **InspireXT****?**

Because transformation, at its best, is human. You’ll work with people who care deeply about what they do, who believe in trust before transactions, and who want to leave every client stronger than they found them. We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. If that sounds like you – we’d love to hear from you. Apply to be part of our growth story.

Note - we are an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering diversity & growth for all. We welcome applications from traditional and unusual backgrounds and also are happy to discuss any specific accommodations required in the recruitment process to help you shine.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.

jobs.description:
Food Safety & Production Supervisor

**Company:** Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd **Location:** Velachery Central Kitchen, Chennai **Reports to:** Head of Operations **Type:** Full-time, on-site (factory-based, with periodic store visits) **Apply to:** jobs@amadora.in

About Amadora

Amadora makes premium artisanal ice cream, baked goods, sauces, bars and cakes from scratch — no premixes, no compounds. Everything is produced at our central kitchen in Chennai on Pastomaster and Carpigiani equipment and distributed to franchise and company-owned stores across Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. As we scale, the discipline of the factory floor is what protects the brand.

The Role

We are looking for a food technologist who has worked as a Food Safety Executive and is ready to own both sides of the floor: making sure production runs the way the process says it should, and making sure food safety norms are followed without exception, every single day.

This is a hands-on shop-floor role, not a desk role. You will be present during production, checking that steps are followed as written, catching deviations while they are still small, and holding the line on hygiene, traceability and equipment condition. Alongside the daily work, you will drive our ISO certification programme and partner with the Training team to take food safety standards out to the stores.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily production supervision

* Verify that every batch is produced to the approved recipe, sequence, temperature and time parameters — pasteurisation, ageing, batch freezing, blast freezing, hardening and packing.
* Run and sign off start-of-shift, in-process and end-of-shift checks; ensure line clearance between batches and between allergen and non-allergen runs.
* Check equipment and tooling condition before use — moulds, scoops, containers, gaskets, blades — and enforce immediate quarantine and physical removal of any damaged, chipped or worn item from the production area.
* Monitor CCPs and record readings in real time; escalate deviations immediately rather than at end of day.
* Verify raw material and packaging at receipt (COA, temperature, condition, shelf life) and enforce FEFO in cold rooms and dry stores.
* Support the production plan — yields, batch sizing, changeover time, wastage — and flag where process adherence and output targets are in conflict.

2. Food safety and hygiene compliance

* Own day-to-day implementation of HACCP, GMP and GHP across the facility.
* Manage personal hygiene, health checks, gowning and handwashing compliance for all production staff.
* Schedule and verify cleaning and sanitation (CIP and manual), pest control, water testing, swab testing and calibration; maintain the records.
* Run the foreign-material control programme: metal, glass, hard plastic, wood and mould-fragment controls, with defined inspection and breakage procedures.
* Manage the finished-goods and shelf-life testing programme, micro sampling and third-party lab coordination.
* Maintain FSSAI licence conditions and Schedule 4 compliance; be the point person for FSSAI and customer audits.
* Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformances to root cause, define CAPA, and verify that the corrective action actually holds a month later.
* Maintain full batch traceability and be able to run a mock recall to closure.

3. ISO / FSSC certification

* Lead preparation for ISO 22000:2018 (and FSSC 22000 where applicable) — gap assessment, documentation, PRPs, HACCP plan, internal audits, management review and closure of certification body findings.
* Build and maintain the food safety management system documentation: manual, procedures, formats, records.
* Train and hand-hold the production team through the changes the certification requires, so the system survives after the certificate is issued.

4. Store food safety, with the Training team

* Work with the Head of Training to convert factory food safety standards into simple, teachable store-level procedures — cold chain, thawing, display, scooping hygiene, cleaning schedules, expiry management, allergen handling.
* Co-create training content, checklists and audit formats for franchise and company-owned stores.
* Conduct periodic store food safety audits, score them, and drive closure of findings with the operations and training teams.
* Support franchisee-side FSSAI compliance and readiness for regulatory inspections.

5. Documentation and reporting

* Maintain daily, weekly and monthly food safety and production compliance dashboards.
* Report non-conformances, wastage, complaint trends and audit scores to management with clear cause and action.

Qualifications and Competencies

**Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Sc / M.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience, including a proven stint as a Food Safety Executive or Officer in a food manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of HACCP, GMP, GHP, FSSAI regulations and Schedule 4.
* Experience preparing for or maintaining ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 certification.
* Comfortable with documentation and record discipline — you can build a format, and you can also make people fill it correctly.
* Physically comfortable working in a cold-chain environment, including chillers and blast freezers, and around early production shifts.

**Preferred**

* Dairy, frozen dessert, bakery or chocolate manufacturing background.
* Certified HACCP Level 3 / ISO 22000 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor.
* Multi-site or retail-outlet audit exposure.
* Working Tamil and English; Kannada or Telugu a bonus given our other markets.

**Competencies we care about**

* Willingness to stop a batch. The right answer is sometimes expensive, and we want someone who says it anyway.
* Firm without being adversarial — you will be enforcing standards on colleagues you work beside every day.
* Bias for root cause over blame; interest in why the process allowed the mistake, not just who made it.
* Attention to detail that holds up on day 200, not just day 20.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

* **Month 1–3:** You have mapped every production line end to end, documented the actual process against the written SOP, and produced a prioritised gap list covering process adherence, hygiene, equipment condition and record-keeping.
* **Month 3–4:** Daily production and food safety checks are running consistently across all shifts, with real-time recording and same-day escalation of deviations — verified by you, not self-reported.
* **Month 6:** The ISO 22000 documentation set is complete, PRPs and the HACCP plan are implemented, and the first full internal audit cycle has been completed with CAPAs closed.
* **Month 6–9:** A store food safety standard, training module and audit checklist are live with the Training team, and the first round of audits is complete across Chennai stores.
* **Month 9–12:** ISO certification audit cleared, with no major non-conformances outstanding.
* **Through the year:** A measurable fall in food-safety-related customer complaints and internal non-conformances, with a traceability and mock-recall capability that closes within the target window.

Why Amadora

You will be the person who owns food safety at a brand that makes everything from scratch — which means real process, real risk and real ownership, not a premix line where the standards were set by someone else. You will build the system, certify it, and take it out to every store. Direct access to the founder and the leadership team, and a company growing fast enough that what you build now becomes how it operates at three times the size.

1. Job Purpose

To conduct regular quality audits across dairy plants, BMCs (Bulk Milk Cooling Centres), milk collection centres, and other operational locations to ensure compliance with quality standards, food safety regulations, hygiene practices, and company policies. The role involves extensive travelling, identifying quality gaps, preparing audit reports, and ensuring timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
