**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* **Brand Builder** - you care deeply about what makes brands distinctive and know how to build equity consistently over time.
* **Consumer Obsessed** - you are curious about people, culture and behaviour and use insight to inform brand strategy.
* **Commercially minded** – you are comfortable converting business objectives into marketing objectives and strategies
* **Analytical** - you are comfortable with data and use it to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* **Hands-on** - you are equally comfortable shaping strategy, reviewing packaging, building a business case, briefing an agency and preparing a customer story.
* **Entrepreneurial** - you are a self-starter who thrives in a growing organisation where not every process or answer already exists.
* **Collaborative** - you build strong relationships across functions, markets and external partners
* **Fast & Pragmatic** - you maintain high standards without sacrificing pace of execution in the pursuit of perfection.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**

* Competitive salary and benefits, in line with the local market and experience.
* Full-time, permanent contract.
* Travel costs covered in line with company policy.

**Location**

This is a full-time, mostly remote position, with frequent European travel. We need this person to be willing to travel frequently around Europe.

**Salary Range:** €45K - €55K

As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Venture Builder (General Manager) - F&B
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Note: OVI is hiring on behalf of a confidential client. This role is not with OVI.**

  

**Venture Builder (General Manager)**

  

Abu Dhabi, UAE (On-site) | Full-time | Reporting to the Owner
  
Develop and grow an established healthy food brand to market leadership.

  

**Role purpose**

  

Take full ownership of an established healthy café and grab-and-go brand in Abu Dhabi and build it into a profitable, scalable business. You will run it as your own: first fix, then grow.
  
In the first phase you professionalise operations, restructure the menu and central kitchen workflows, and bring every outlet to strong unit economics. In the second you build what comes next: new revenue streams, a sharper concept and a model that is ready to multiply.
  
This is a role for a builder. You get a brand customers already know, a central kitchen, three locations, a team, and the freedom to decide.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Operational leadership

  

• Build and implement scalable SOPs across the outlets and the central kitchen.
  
• Introduce KPI-based performance management and weekly operating routines.
  
• Improve labour scheduling, cost-of-goods discipline, waste control and speed of service.
  
• Simplify and standardise workflows, menu and ingredient use.
  
Turnaround and unit economics
  
• Remove operational bottlenecks and improve unit economics at the existing outlets.
  
• Deliver profitability at outlet and company level within a defined timeframe.
  
• Optimise the central kitchen and put its spare capacity to work.
  
P&L ownership
  
• Full responsibility for financial performance across all outlets and channels.
  
• Build reporting dashboards and operational transparency.
  
• Maintain budget discipline on operating and capital expenditure.
  
Growth and venture building
  
• Identify, test and launch new revenue streams, for example corporate catering, smart fridges, wholesale and subscriptions.
  
• Develop the next version of the concept: menu, pricing, format and customer experience.
  
• Build the business case and the operating model for expansion.
  
Team leadership
  
• Lead and develop the chef, the central kitchen team and the outlet teams.
  
• Hire and grow the key people a larger business will need.
  
• Build a culture of performance and accountability.

  

**Candidate profile**

  

Core experience

  

• 7+ years in F&B operations or high-growth ventures, including several in a leadership role.
  
• Proven multi-unit experience and full ownership of a P&L.
  
• Turnaround experience: you have fixed a struggling unit, business or system.
  
• Strong exposure to the GCC market; UAE experience required.
  
• Background in fast-casual/healthy food groups (e.g. Joe & the Juice, Pinza, Wild & the Moon, SALT), cloud/central kitchen operators (e.g. Kitopi, Kaykroo, Deliveroo Editions, Sweetheart Kitchen), or fast-growing food start-ups/venture building as a founder or early leader.
  
Operational skill set
  
• Playbook builder: SOPs, training, checklists and productivity systems.
  
• Central kitchen workflows, food preparation, yield and cross-utilisation of ingredients.
  
• Deep understanding of unit economics and F&B KPI dashboards.
  
• High-throughput formats: bowls, salads, smoothies, coffee, grab-and-go.
  
• Hands-on approach. This is not a corporate management role.
  
Leadership & personality fit
  
• Founder-like ownership: you treat the business and its money as your own.
  
• Structured, disciplined, fast in execution, decisive under pressure, high accountability, low ego, not political or hierarchical.
  
• Enjoys building, not maintaining.

  

**Why this role**

  

• Lead the transformation of an established brand and build its next chapter.
  
• Real autonomy: direct line to the owner and full decision-making authority.
  
• High-execution role where results are visible from the first month, with pay that grows with performance.

Dubai, United Arab Emirates

jobs.title: Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
  
  
We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
  
  
Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**About Jumeirah**
Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
  
**About Madinat Jumeirah:**
Set along a two-kilometre stretch of private coastline, Madinat Jumeirah is a beachfront resort comprising four distinctive hotels. Each offers uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, with experiences ranging from the contemporary elegance of Jumeirah Al Naseem to the majestic Arabesque charm of Jumeirah Al Qasr. Guests can also enjoy the serene waterfront setting of Jumeirah Mina Al Salam and the secluded Arabian houses of Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf. The Executive Pastry Chef is responsible for leading the creation, development and execution of premium pastry and dessert concepts across Independent Food Company's portfolio, including the development and launch of new pastry brands.

The role combines brand creation, culinary innovation, product development and operational leadership, ensuring that each concept delivers a distinctive identity, exceptional product quality, commercial viability and a consistent guest experience.

The incumbent will lead the end-to-end culinary development of new pastry brands, from initial concept creation and menu development through kitchen design and layout planning, recipe standardization, equipment selection, team recruitment, training and successful operational launch.

While the role carries strategic and creative responsibilities, the Executive Pastry Chef must remain fully hands-on, actively participating in product development, tastings, production trials, training and new brand openings.

**Pastry Brand Creation & Concept Development**

1. Lead the culinary creation and development of new pastry, bakery and dessert brands, from initial concept ideation through commercial launch.

1. Lead all pastry-related workstreams for new brand openings, ensuring culinary and operational readiness within approved timelines.

6. Support recruitment, technical assessments and selection of pastry teams for new concepts.

POSITION VACANCY

Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness

POSITION SNAPSHOT

Company: Nestlé

Location: Dubai - HQ

POSITION SUMMARY

Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.

A DAY IN THE LIFE …

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.

* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.

* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.

* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.

* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.

* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.

* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)

* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.

* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.

* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.

* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.

* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.

* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.

* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.

* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

**Location: Northeast**

**Territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI**

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area
* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs—to troubleshoot recruitment challenges and streamline processes
* Monitor site performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve enrollment rates.
* Support investigator meetings, site initiation visits, and ongoing trial communications
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs while fostering trust and transparency with stakeholders
* Supports Medical Affairs initiatives (advisory board meetings) and informs medical strategy through capturing and reporting of medical insights
* Keeps current on disease state, therapeutic landscape, and competitor data and records insights
* Utilize effective, confident, and professional communications to establish strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Respond to and documents unsolicited medical requests (MIRs) for information in a timely manner
* Support Market Access by educating payers (Health plans and state Medicaids) and key decision makers (Pharmacists and P&T Committees) on the clinical efficacy and safety profile to support formulary decisions
* Liaise unsolicited submissions and information for investigator-initiated trials (IITs) between the investigator and home office Medical Affairs
* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities

Professional Experience/Qualifications

* A scientific or clinical professional with a passion for science and deep scientific knowledge
* At least 2 years of experience in a Medical Science Liaison or similar role (MG disease experience preferred); will consider candidates with > 5 years of MG clinical experience
* Must have well-established networks and active relationships with KOLs in the MG community
* Strong knowledge of GCP guidelines and clinical trial processes
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex science into clear, actionable insights
* Energetically embraces responsibilities, demonstrates initiative, and excellent time management
* Agile, adaptable
* A collaborative mindset and genuine passion for improving patient outcomes
* Field-based, with the ability to travel approximately 75%

Education

* Advanced Scientific or Clinical degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP) with a minimum of 2 years of relevant clinical or pharmaceutical experience; NP or PA with 5 or more years clinical experience in MG will be considered. Must reside in the territory.

*Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The company does not sponsor employment visas for this position.*

****أهداف الوظيفة****

  

إثبات المصروفات والإيرادات و تسجيل الاصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية و إعداد التسويات البنكية وإصدار التقارير ذات العلاقة.

  

****اهم المسؤوليات****

  

1.استلام فواتير الموردين وتصنيفها عن طريق إدخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

2.إعداد سندات الصرف واصدار الشيكات او التحويلات البنكية و متابعة الحصول على التوقيعات اللازمة وفقا للصلاحيات المعتمدة لصرف المبالغ الصحيحة.

  

3.إثبات كافة قيود العمليات المحاسبية حسب التوجيه المحاسبي السليم وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة .

  

4.إعداد التسويات البنكية الدورية وإعداد التسويات اللازمة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة عن طريق إجراء المقارنات بين فواتير المدفوعات والإيرادات و الدفعات البنكية.

  

5.صرف كشوفات الرواتب الشهرية لموظفي الهيئة عن طريق التحويلات البنكية وفقاً للإجراءات المحاسبية المعتمدة ومتابعة الحصول على الإعتمادات اللازمة للصرف.

  

6.إثبات المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية بغرض إثباتها في الحسابات.

  

7.صرف المنافع المالية ( المنفعة الدورية – منفعة تجهيز مسكن – منفعة السكن المؤقت ) من خلال بطاقات المستفيدين للمنفعة .

  

8.إثبات الإيرادات الخاصة بالتراخيص وإعداد الايصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً للبنود الخاصة بها .

  

9.استلام تقارير التشغيلية لقاعات الأفراح (مثال : قاعات الطوار والبرشاء) من مركز دبي التجاري و مراجعتها وإثبات الإيرادات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية

  

10.التأكد من تحويل ايرادات قاعات الافراح من خلال موقع البنك و إعداد الإيصالات في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

11.التحقق من استلام الشيكات و التحويلات البنكية للمبالغ الواردة من اموال الزكاة و التبرعات و اثباتها في انظمة الموارد الحكومية.

  

12.استلام أوامر صرف أموال الزكاه والمساهمات المجتمعية والتبرعات ولجنة صندوق التضامن و لجنه الحالات الانسانية و ادخالها في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية واثباتها في حسابات الهيئة بهدف توزيعها على الحسابات ذات العلاقة ليتم صرفها للمستحقين وفقاً للاجراءات المعتمدة.

  

13.متابعة ملاحظات الإغلاق الشهري لحسابات الهيئة عن طريق إصدار التقارير المالية من خلال أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية.

  

14.تسجيل الأصول الثابتة في أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية لأثباتها في دفاتر حسابات الهيئة.

  

15.المشاركة في فريق الجرد السنوي لإجراء عمليات الجرد السنوية ومطابقتها مع أرصدة الحسابات الموجودة في الأستاذ العام.

  

16.التنسيق مع موظفي المشتريات فيما يتعلق بدفعات الموردين وإعداد مطابقات حسابات الموردين وإعتمادها.

  

17.إعداد التقارير الدورية عن الإيرادات والمصروفات عن طريق أنظمة تخطيط الموارد الحكومية وفقاً لمتطلبات الأقسام .

  

18.مراجعة ومطابقة الفواتير مع طلبات الشراء المعتمدة ورفع التوصيات بالمتطلبات مثل ( عقود الشركات ، رسائل تجديد العقود ، العروض المالية للشركات وما إلى ذلك )

  

19.استلام الإيرادات النقدية وإيداعها في حساب البنكي الخاص بإيرادات حكومة دبي.

  

20.الإلتزام بسياسات وإجراءات أمن المعلومات المعتمدة بالهيئة والعمل على الامتثال بالضوابط لضمان سرية المعلومات

  

21.أية مهام أو اختصاصات في نطاق مسؤوليات الوظيفة.

  

****المتطلبات التعليمية****

  

·بكالوريس في المحاسبة أو ما يعادلها.

  

·اجادة اللغتين الانكليزية والعربية(محادثة وكتابة)

  

****متطلبات الخبرة****

  

من 0 – 2 سنوات خبرة في الحسابات.

jobs.title: Branch Accountant | Al-Futtaim Automotive| Dubai
jobs.description:
About Al-Futtaim

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview of the role**

  

We are currently hiring a detail-oriented **Branch Accountant** to support the day-to-day finance operations of a busy automotive branch in the UAE.

  

In this role, you will help ensure that financial transactions are accurate, properly documented, reconciled and processed on time. You will provide operational finance support across sales, aftersales, parts and administration, covering customer collections, vendor payments, banking, petty cash, vehicle deal documentation and month-end closing activities.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Review daily branch transactions, including invoices, receipts, customer collections, vendor payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* Check vehicle deal documentation, pricing requests and discount approvals for accuracy and completeness.
* Monitor cash collections, card receipts, bank deposits, petty cash and other banking activities.
* Prepare reconciliations for customer accounts, vendor balances, deposits, advances, clearing accounts and petty cash.
* Investigate outstanding balances, transaction errors and reconciling items, escalating unresolved issues when required.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, provisions, reclassifications, journals and expense reviews.
* Track operating expenses, purchase orders, supplier invoices and cost-centre postings.
* Identify missing approvals, documentation gaps, unusual financial movements and control exceptions.
* Maintain accurate schedules, trackers and supporting documentation for reporting and audit purposes.
* Ensure branch finance activities comply with applicable financial policies, approval requirements and internal controls.
* Coordinate with branch operations, shared services, treasury, credit control and other finance stakeholders.

**Required skills to be successful**

  

* Good understanding of accounting principles and day-to-day financial transactions.
* Strong reconciliation skills and numerical accuracy.
* Knowledge of receivables, payables, banking, petty cash, accruals and financial controls.
* Good Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to maintain accurate trackers and schedules.
* Working knowledge of SAP or a similar ERP system.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Ability to identify transaction errors, missing approvals and outstanding reconciling items.
* Good communication and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage daily priorities and meet month-end deadlines.
* A reliable, accountable and process-focused approach to work.

**About the team**

  

You will join a collaborative automotive finance team supporting a high-volume branch environment. You will work closely with the Finance Manager, branch management, sales, service and parts teams, as well as shared services, treasury and credit control.

  

The team plays an important role in maintaining strong financial discipline while providing responsive support to daily branch operations.

  

**What equips you for the role**

  

* A degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.
* **2–4 years of relevant experience** in accounting, branch finance, retail finance, dealership finance or operational finance support.
* Experience preparing reconciliations and supporting month-end closing activities.
* Experience reviewing financial documentation and following up on outstanding items.
* Exposure to automotive, retail, trading or another high-volume transactional environment is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP system is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during month-end and peak transaction periods.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

  

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

  

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

  

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

  

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.title: Quality Technologist
jobs.company: National Food Products Company | NFPC Group
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Home to some of the UAE’s best-loved brands, including Lacnor, Laban Up, Oasis, Milco and Safa, NFPC is looking for a
**Quality Technologist**
to join our Quality team.

**JOB PURPOSE**

The Quality Technologist ensures that Fresh and UHT products meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and regulatory compliance. They analyze product samples and run routine tests, including pH, conductivity, and the concentration of chemicals used, and they assess packaging materials. They also apply hygiene best practices across operations, carry out internal audits, and keep accurate quality records. Working within the quality team, they implement and maintain quality standards, procedures, and systems that meet UAE regulatory requirements and support consistent product quality.

**ESSENTIAL ACCOUNTABILITIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND KPIs**

**Testing & Analysis**

* Perform physical, chemical, and microbiological tests on raw milk, ingredients, and finished dairy products, including fat, protein, titratable acidity, pH, moisture, and microbiological counts.
* Carry out environmental and allergen swabbing to verify sanitation effectiveness.
* Test packaging integrity and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for corrective action.

**Process Control**

* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational parameters across pasteurisation, fermentation, filling, and packaging. Make sure CCPs stay within defined limits and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for immediate corrective action.

**Raw & Packaging Materials**

* Inspect incoming raw and packaging materials in line with the company’s raw material receiving programme. Prepare summary reports on supplier ratings and material disposition.
* Take part in qualifying new ingredients, raw materials, and packaging materials, including machine runnability, stability testing, and pre-commercial and commercial trials.
* Lead the closure of packaging-related Non-Conformance Action Reports (NCARs), including reviewing and validating suppliers’ corrective and preventive actions.

**Compliance & Audits**

* Ensure compliance with HACCP, ISO, FSSC 22000, and other food safety and quality management systems.
* Implement Food Safety and Quality Assurance (FSQA) procedures across manufacturing and supply chain functions to reduce food safety risks.
* Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, and maintain accurate quality documentation.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of quality assurance or quality control experience, preferably in dairy or juice manufacturing.
* HACCP Level 3 certification.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Food and Safety - Madinat Jumeirah Resorts
jobs.description:
**About Jumeirah**

Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

**About Madinat Jumeirah**

Set along a two-kilometre stretch of private coastline, Madinat Jumeirah is a beachfront resort comprising four distinctive hotels. Each offers uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, with experiences ranging from the contemporary elegance of Jumeirah Al Naseem to the majestic Arabesque charm of Jumeirah Al Qasr. Guests can also enjoy the serene waterfront setting of Jumeirah Mina Al Salam and the secluded Arabian houses of Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf. Together, they form a one-of-a-kind destination rooted in Arabian luxury hospitality. The resort features over 20 curated restaurants and lounges, the traditional Souk Madinat Jumeirah, dedicated kids' clubs and some of the region’s most versatile event and conference spaces

**About the Job**

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an
**Associate Director - Food and Safety**
to join
**Madinat Jumeirah**

The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:

* Define and maintain
  **Food Safety & Hygiene standards**
  , ensuring compliance with HSE policies, regulations, industry best practices, and communicable disease controls.
* Coordinate
  **HACCP and third-party certification audits**
  , monitor findings, identify trends, and ensure corrective actions are implemented across SBUs.
* Manage relationships with
  **food safety authorities, laboratories, auditors, pest control contractors, suppliers, and government bodies**
  .
* Review food safety reports, oversee
  **food sampling programs and complaint investigations**
  , including suspected food poisoning, and recommend improvements.
* Develop and deliver
  **Food Safety & Hygiene training, workshops, and SOPs**
  , ensuring teams remain updated and compliant with required standards.
* Partner with
  **Supply Chain**
  on supplier and catering vendor selection, while continuously improving food safety policies, procedures, and operational controls.

**About you**

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

* MSc in
  **Microbiology, Food Technology, Food Science**
  , or a related field.
* Advanced certification in
  **Food Hygiene Management**
  and
  **Level 3 HACCP / Food Safety Principles**
  .
* **5–8 years of HSE management experience**
  within the hospitality or food industry.
* Strong knowledge of
  **food safety, hygiene regulations, HACCP, and local policies**
  , with a solid understanding of luxury hospitality operations.
* Excellent
  **communication, relationship management, decision-making, problem-solving, and proactive leadership skills**
  ; ISO 22000/ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification is an advantage.

**About the Benefits**

At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.

Benefits include:

* Supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to Learning & Development programmes and clear career pathways
* Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network
* Colleague discounts on food, beverage, and hotel stays worldwide
* Comprehensive healthcare and life insurance coverage
* Paid annual leave entitlement
* Performance-based incentives tailored to your role
* Competitive tax-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED)
